claude_code.supported_min_source: the .claude-plugin/marketplace.json schema this catalog ships has been stable since 2.0.0; the previous floor was never validated
claude_code.verification_method: Real direct CLI check this run — `claude --version` on the runner reports 2.1.247, the second consecutive run with a live CLI available (the previous run closed the 2.1.241/2.1.245 validated_against/latest_known gap at 2.1.246; this run holds both figures equal again at 2.1.247). `claude plugin validate --strict .agents/skills` was re-run against this live 2.1.247 CLI and passed clean, and `claude plugin marketplace add`-style catalog resolution was re-checked via `make validate` (regenerate + validate manifests; 3 plugins in sync, no drift). The 2.1.247 changelog delta was reviewed line-by-line against the catalog surface. Two items are directly about marketplace/catalog behavior and got a real check, not a rubber stamp: (1) the version-less marketplace plugin cache directory fix (a plugin install in a second scope could delete the first scope's cache directory when the plugin declares no `version` field) — checked directly against `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`: none of this catalog's three plugin entries (`tamirs-superpowers`, `jose-claudinho`, `headhunter`) declare a `version` field, so this catalog's installs are exactly the version-less case the bug describes; documented as a new Troubleshooting row and install-guide note; (2) plugin marketplace hardening (control/invisible character rejection, escape-safe text) — checked directly with a Unicode category scan (`unicodedata.category` starting with `C`) over every plugin `name` and `description` string in all three manifests (`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`, `.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json`) — zero hits, this catalog's entries were already clean. Also checked: the `/claude-api` skill's new Admin API coverage and `/claude-api cost-optimize` subcommand — this catalog ships no `claude-api` skill and no Python/Anthropic-SDK code, so not applicable. Everything else in 2.1.247 (`SendFeedback` tool, `spinnerTipsOverride`/`tipsFile` tip rotation, Bash permission-prompt auto-mode tip, arrow-key/history-search input fixes, sub-agent model-404 fallback-chain fix, hook/background-agent error-output overflow fix, non-Latin Ctrl-shortcut and split mouse-report fixes, Bash sandbox dotfile-symlink fix, `/terminal-setup` Zed keymap merge fix, `/rename` silent-confirm fix, `/compact` system-prompt fix, background-session UI/memory fixes, `/install-github-app` SSH messaging, Remote Control diff reporting, self-hosted runner status timing, first-run managed-gateway connectivity fix, cloud-session permission-mode/container-restart fixes, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry MCP-failure messaging, Sonnet 5's full-1M auto-compact window, cross-session peer-message collapse, terminal hyperlink rendering, PR-badge refresh-skip, and analytics/gateway/sign-in changes) is host/CLI/session-side with no marketplace-manifest surface. Prior verification still holds: catalog install previously verified with `claude plugin marketplace add Tamircohen28/tamirs-marketplace` followed by `claude plugin install <name>@tamirs-marketplace`.

opencode.supported_min_source: oldest version on which `skills.paths` discovery of a catalog plugin's skills was verified with `opencode debug skill`
opencode.verification_method: opencode --version on the maintainer machine; latest from registry.npmjs.org/opencode-ai. OpenCode has no marketplace, so the catalog itself cannot be installed — each plugin repo is cloned and its skills verified with `opencode debug skill`

capability_gaps.marketplace: OpenCode has no plugin marketplace and no plugin manifest, so this catalog cannot be added as an install source. Each plugin repo is installed directly — clone it and point `skills.paths` at its `skills/` directory, or symlink it into the OpenCode skills directory. Every plugin in this catalog ships its own `opencode.json` and its own OpenCode install guide.
capability_gaps.catalog_discovery: There is no OpenCode equivalent of listing plugins from a remote catalog. The plugin table in this repo's README is the discovery surface; installation is then per-repo.
